attributes.name: character_backstory
attributes.current:
I was born and raised in the city of derblaise, a place with people devout to the god Atreidin, my family were devout followers of atreiding, and my father managed the school of conquest and my mother worked at the family general store. growing up, my parents would tell me stories of Atreidin and legends of Walt rivers, at which i was always fascinated by. besides taking up dueling and fighting with large, bulky weapons like halberds and greatswords, I had a fairly uneventful childhood, as derblaise was a mid-sized town in the country and didn't really have a lot of good to trade or wealth to attract malicious elements. we were more of a self-sustaining community with very strict traditions which we followed for multiple generations. when i reached adulthood, i was given a bracelet which had the holy symbol of Atreidin branded onto it. it was hand crafted by one of the most respected learners of our school, and the bronze that it was made from was said to be mined from one of the most important places in our mythology. the divine power that was possessed by it let me channel the divine powers of Atreidin, i also joined the school to learn and teach our philosophy. as i went through adulthood, i learned of the evils and unfairness that lie around in the world, and decided that i would traverse it, conquering evil, and obliterating it, just like Walt rivers did. *this leads me to travel around and get on that train*
#Got it#
